0.2.0.en: First release in the Homey App Store. Sends your devices, zones, energy and climate readings to a TRMNL e-ink display — on a timer and immediately whenever something in the home changes.

0.2.2.en: Corrected the app icon and store images to the TRMNL brand.

0.3.0.en: Pushing when a device changes is now a setting, and off by default. A busy home can use up the hourly push allowance in minutes, so it is now opt-in and spaced at least a minute apart.

0.3.1.en: Updated the App Store images to a real Homey screen.

0.4.0.en: Sends every capability your devices report, not just power, temperature and humidity. A TRMNL screen can now show battery levels, air quality, thermostat modes, washer programs and anything else Homey knows about.

0.4.1.en: Updated the App Store images to show every capability with Homey's own glyphs.

0.4.3.en: Added a Flow card that sends your home to TRMNL, and sharper App Store images.

0.4.5.en: Made the app icon visible on its brand color.

0.4.6.en: Enlarged the app icon to fill its canvas.

0.4.7.en: Your screen now shows current readings instead of the readings from when the app started. Push on change now reacts to new readings, and each change sends one push instead of two.
